proposal.reason: Main change is new host one-sided RMA Put/Signal/WaitSignal execution over CE (new rma_ce path, signaling/ack protocol, chunked >1GB puts, CE init/finalize), so copy-engine is primary. Enqueue is additionally required because new RMA task types are validated, queued, batched, planned, launched, and cleaned up in the runtime planner/group launch flow. Communicator is additionally required because capability gating, config (`numRmaCtx`), platform/team checks, window-registration-triggered RMA CE initialization, and communicator properties/lifecycle teardown are changed.
